regime: Relief bounce after forced selling: metals and tech rebound together, oil stays high
takeaway: Gold rose about 2.3% to near $3,648 and silver about 6% to near $43.90 from multi-month lows, pulling the gold/silver ratio down to about 83, which eases the forced-selling and silver-stress checks for now. Tech futures were up over 2% and the VIX slipped to about 25, while the 10-year yield rose to 4.90% with a December Fed hike still fully priced. Brent is holding near $97 ahead of Sunday's OPEC+ meeting, so the oil-shock check stays in view, and today's shortened, thin session can exaggerate moves in leveraged funds.
